references.text: The Levites were appointed to have responsibility for the tabernacle of the testimony and all its equipment
The Levites were to perform service for Aaron and the whole congregation in front of the tent of meeting and take care of the tabernacle's equipment
Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the tabernacle on the east side and keep watch over the sanctuary
The Levites were given to Aaron and his sons to prevent disaster from coming upon the people of Israel when they approached the sanctuary
God's wrath (קֶצֶף) broke out against the congregation, and Aaron had to make atonement for the people
The priests and Levites were to keep watch over the sanctuary so that wrath would not come upon the people of Israel
Refers to the tabernacle as 'the tabernacle of the testimony' (מִשְׁכַּן הָעֵדֻת) where the Levites served
Shows that God's wrath (קֶצֶף) came upon the entire congregation of Israel because of one man's sin
Shows that God's wrath (קֶצֶף) could come upon Israel if the service was not carried out correctly
